separation-family.alt: The slope field of dy/dx = xy on −2.5 ≤ x ≤ 2.5 and −4 ≤ y ≤ 4, with the curves y = Ce^(x²/2) for C = 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 in crimson above the x-axis, for C = −0.25, −0.5, −1, −2 in blue below it, and C = 0, the x-axis itself, in green. Each curve is flattest at x = 0 and follows the segments.
